g.text: (c) V3 and its uninformative ablation share the
Figure H. Independent holdout H1: V3 beats angular maximin and V2 (pre-registered, Holm-corrected), but V3 driven by isotropic von Mises responses does equally well —
the gain is a sampling-geometry effect, not response-adaptive discovery. Analytic surfaces only: on the physical TL1 truss the advantage did not transfer (Figure G).
